days.title: Backyard Obstacle Course
days.description: Set up 5 stations in the garden: crawl under a table, hop through hoops, balance a beanbag on your head, toss a ball into a bucket, and sprint to the finish. Everyone gets two tries — keep your best time!
tips: Use whatever you have — chairs, cushions, skipping ropes
Younger players can skip a station with a helping hand
Cheer loud — that's half the fun!

days.title: Paper Airplane Target Practice
days.description: Fold your best paper airplane and stand behind a line. You have 15 throws at a target (a laundry basket or taped square on the wall). Count how many land inside!
tips: Try different folds — see what flies farthest
Move the line closer for little ones

days.title: Family Summer Trivia
days.description: 20 questions about holidays, sunshine, ice cream, and silly facts. One point per correct answer. Work alone or in pairs — your choice!

days.title: Guess the Summer Tune
days.description: One person hums a summer song while everyone else writes down their guess. Most creative wrong answers get a bonus shout-out!
tips: No phones for looking up lyrics!
Wrong answers are often the best part

days.title: Book-on-Head Balance Walk
days.description: Balance a book on your head and walk a marked course without using your hands. Time starts when you step off the line and stops when you finish — or when the book falls!
